# marked, with a photo
Edit the first attached picture: it is part of black line art for a one-piece wall cut-out, about 240 mm wide, 3D-printed in black. The second attached picture is the same part with the area to change outlined in magenta; the third is the whole drawing, for context only.
Change only this inside the outlined area: make the rider look like the man in the photo
The attached photo shows the real subject: use it for the part you change.
Keep everything else exactly as it is: the same picture size and framing, and every line outside the outlined area where it is, at the same weight; copy them, don't redraw them. Answer with the first picture changed, without the magenta outline.
Rules for what you change:
- pure black (#000000) lines on pure white (#FFFFFF), the same line weight and bold, simplified style as the rest of the picture; no grey, shading, hatching or textures
- it joins the lines around it, so the drawing stays ONE connected piece with nothing floating or dangling
- no detail smaller than about three line widths; no text, signature or watermark
- every line that crosses the edge of the outlined area carries on across it where it was, at the same weight
